rv.q: In such troubled and fretful times, Birbiglia's take on ultimate themes is refreshingly offbeat and diverting, but I did not find it as funny as the crowd around me.
In a mash-up between stand-up comedy and theatre 'Mike Birbiglia's The Man and the Pool' is an engaging and truly funny hit of a show.

cn.t: Critics find Birbiglia's one-man show charming and well-crafted, though responses range from enthusiastic to moderately warm, with his storytelling style and personal reflections earning consistent praise.
